title: feat(plugin-detail): bound record blocks draw an authored emptyState when their binding answers no row (objectui#12932)
body:
Fixes #12932
Clause-②: yes (the three bound record blocks publish the `emptyState` input that `@objectstack/spec` declares at objectui's pin `f4755a68a797`, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24266 landed as `586705d85d`)

## What this does

This is the renderer half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#24266. `record:details`, `record:highlights` and `record:quick_actions` now draw their authored `emptyState` when the block's `dataSource` binding answers no row.

- **Where it is drawn.** `BoundRecordScope` in `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordBinding.tsx` reads the block's `emptyState`. It hands the drawing to `BoundRecordProvider` as its `absent` slot. That slot was added for `record:related_list`'s `parentDataSource` and already draws in the block's place when the settled read has no row. So the condition is the one the spec's describe states. The block carries a binding and the read settled with no row. A read refused as forbidden reads as no row today, so the empty state is drawn for that too, as the spec's describe says.
- **What it does not touch.**
  - While the read is loading, the block shows its loading state.
  - A failed read draws the error panel (objectui#11902 stays as it is).
  - A bound row draws the row.
  - An unbound block never reaches this read, so it renders as before.
- **The drawing.** `BoundRecordEmptyState` uses the same pieces `ObjectGrid` uses for its own authored `emptyState`:
  - `DataEmptyState`;
  - `resolveIcon` for `icon`;
  - the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` for `title` and `message`, against the display locale;
  - the shared `EmptyStateLink` for `link`.

  The only difference is the default heading. When `title` is left out, it reads `detail.recordNotFound` ("Record not found"), the words `record:details` already uses. The grid's "No results found" would describe a table.
- **Published.** One `BOUND_RECORD_EMPTY_STATE_INPUT` (`type: 'object'`) is added to the `inputs` of all three registrations in `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`. The three `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` booked to this card in `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` are struck. Once published, each `emptyState` is a structured input, so the gate's member-shape census requires a `MEMBER_PINS` row for each of the three. All three rows point at the new test file. Only these three rows were edited; the `list-view` rows (objectui#13047) are untouched.

## Defaults: what a block with no `emptyState` draws

Each block keeps today's default, as ruled:
- `record:details` draws "Record not found".
- `record:highlights` draws nothing.
- `record:quick_actions` draws its empty bar. On a runtime view that is nothing, since objectui#12995 / objectui#13000. On a design or preview surface it is the dashed placeholder.

`record:highlights` was **not** given a loud default. The spec's own describe of this key at the pin says "nothing on `record:highlights`" is the 0-row placeholder. The card's "the default stays the loud renderer text" reads to me as "do not make the default blank", not "change the strip". The report raises it as an open question.

## Tests (all at `45225e8700`)

New file: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/recordBinding.emptyState-12932.test.tsx`, 25 tests. It goes through the real registrations and `SchemaRenderer`, with the key in the `properties` bag.

- **(a)** For each block, 0 rows plus an authored `emptyState` draws the title and message. A forbidden read draws them too.
- **(b)** For each block, 0 rows without `emptyState` draws the block's own default, and no empty-state node.
- **(c) Controls**, for each block:
  - a bound row draws the row;
  - a failed read draws the `-datasource-error` panel, not the empty state;
  - an unbound block on a record page draws the page's record. With no record, it draws its own default, and the adapter is never read.
- **Members** (on `record:details`):
  - a missing `title` gives the default heading;
  - a `title` locale map draws the `en` entry;
  - `icon` resolves (`svg.lucide-server`);
  - `link` draws `EmptyStateLink`.

On the first run, the unbound control was red because of a fixture slip: a default parameter turned `undefined` back into the binding. The red came from the empty state being drawn on what the test thought was an unbound block. That shows the control can fail in the direction it guards.

**Ablation 1: the draw.** `absent` was replaced with `absent={undefined}` in `BoundRecordScope`, using `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor went from 1 to 0 hits, and the blob went from `3c8e41896558` to `38121555a8d8`.
- 10 tests went red: all six (a) tests and all four member tests.
- 15 stayed green: (b), (c) and the input pins.
- Restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD (`3c8e41896558`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**Ablation 2: the publication.** The input's `name` was changed to `emptyStateAblated`. The blob went from `e6a73373f33d` to `4ffafd522a8a`.
- 14 tests went red: in the parity gate, the "publishes every top-level key", "declares no input the spec does not accept" and member-pin tests for all three blocks, plus the census and the check that every member pin names a key that is still structured; in the new file, the three "publishes the `emptyState` input" tests.
- Restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD (`e6a73373f33d`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates (local, at `45225e8700`)

- `vitest run --maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock:
  - the new file: 25 of 25 passed;
  - the parity test plus the objectui#12294 binding test plus the new file: 3 files, 307 tests passed;
  - `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/`, the five `plugin-detail` registry-input pins and the one other test importing the package entry: 103 files, 1089 tests passed;
  - `sdui-intrinsics-compile-11075` and `sdui-manifest-build-11403`: 13 tests passed.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `type-check` (source and `tsconfig.test.json`, after building the dependency closure): exit 0.
- `@object-ui/console` `type-check`: **NOT MEASURED**. The console's dependency closure (about 40 packages) is not built in this worktree. The run failed only on unresolved `@object-ui/*` imports (TS2307 / TS2882). None of the failures is on an edited line, and those lines are object-literal data rows. Declared to CI.
- eslint on the four changed source and test files: 0 errors. The warnings are the files' existing `react-refresh` and `no-explicit-any` classes.
- The battery all exited 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check:new-line-citations`.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, `no-artifact`. It needs the whole workspace built. Recorded, not fixed.
- The full `plugin-detail` and `apps/console` directories are declared to CI.

## Patch round (seat ruling `6271857155`), heads `dad3a01f72` / `1e38ac6195`

- **Q1, A:** a bound `record:highlights` with 0 rows and no `emptyState` keeps drawing nothing. The spec describe at the pin names nothing as its placeholder, so no change.
- **Spec floor:** `@object-ui/plugin-detail` moves `@objectstack/spec` from `^18.0.0-next.3` to `^18.0.0-next.5`, the first published release carrying objectstack `586705d85d`.
  - `npm view` shows next.4 was never published.
  - `git merge-base --is-ancestor 586705d85d` gives exit 1 against the `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.3` tag and exit 0 against `…next.5`.
  - The packed tarballs agree: next.5 has 7 hits for `BOUND_RECORD_BLOCK_EMPTY_STATE_DESCRIPTION`, next.3 has 0.
  - The lockfile does not move, because the importer resolves the spec through the pin override.
- **Authoring type:**
  - A tsc probe: `RecordDetailsComponentProps` and `RecordHighlightsComponentProps` refused a typed `emptyState` (TS2353). Both now declare `emptyState?: EmptyState`, by reference from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. The reverse leg `{ heading }` is refused, naming the spec's member set.
  - `@object-ui/types` has no `RecordQuickActionsComponentProps`; `record:quick_actions` is typed through the zod face, which takes the spec row by reference and already carries `emptyState`.
  - The changeset gains `'@object-ui/types': minor`.
- **Ledger:** `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` loses one `CLAIM_DEBT` line (`RecordHighlightsComponentProps`), regenerated by the script's own `--claim-ledger`. Its spec-alignment claim is now structural, and the ratchet requires the debt row to go.
- **Docs:** the `plugin-detail` README (bound record blocks, with an example) and `content/docs/guide/data-source.md` (the 0-row paragraph) document `emptyState`: when it is drawn, its members, the default title and the per-block defaults.
- **Gates:**
  - `packages/types` full directory: 388 files, 10551 tests.
  - Targeted: 24 files, 756 tests.
  - The script's own suites: 12 files, 343 tests.
  - Build and type-check of `types` and `plugin-detail`: exit 0.
  - `check:spec-symbols`: 0 after the burn-down.
  - Scoped `check:spec-floors`: plugin-detail 0 findings. For types, 2 pre-existing `floor-too-low` findings, filed separately by the seat.
  - `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples`: NOT MEASURED (precondition: the doc-imported packages are not built); declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Spec describe.** The spec's `BOUND_RECORD_BLOCK_EMPTY_STATE_DESCRIPTION` still opens with its "PLANNED, not yet rendered" marker. The seat hands off that edit and the `liveness/page.json` note to objectstack's `domain:spec` seat at landing.
